note: The shelf a new ARK gets: picked for what is worth playing, a handful per console. Every file came from the community catalogue this box trusts, its sha256 was recorded, and it was proved to be the console it claims before anything is published. Whatever licence the source states is kept as provenance and shown on the game's own page.
